scope: Protected action replay representation and additive schema foundation
behavior: AES-256-GCM protects JSON replay results with a fresh nonce and authenticated tenant/invocation identity.
Wrong keys, modified nonce/tag/ciphertext, malformed envelopes and different tenant/invocation contexts reject without echoing protected values.
Additive nullable replay_output_encrypted migration preserves legacy output_json; downgrade refuses existing protected results.
Migration test persists/decrypts actual envelopes on PostgreSQL and a tenant-distributed Citus table, then verifies safe downgrade after protected results are removed.
limits: Worker execution does not yet use this representation; invocation output redaction remains incomplete.
Key retrieval/availability must be validated before executing side effects; rotation and mixed-worker upgrade behavior still need implementation/validation.
Models/API/export must exclude private replay fields before enabling writers.
Tests use rollback-only schemas; full migration chain and native CI remain unverified.
